title: Reproduce the core library fingerprint
acceptance: Run archive verification on a local 1.76.1 copy and report the engine SHA-256 and command result.

title: Reproduce the core ELF report
acceptance: Generate the core report and compare its build ID, executable segment bytes and unwind count with the published report.

title: Measure one offline mechanic in a controlled test
acceptance: Use the pinned 1.76.1 ARM64 build. Change one input, repeat the baseline and changed run, and report the measurements, units and uncertainty.
